correctness.rationale: Tame total ramification at the four distinct branch points gives genus four. The four indicated forms have finite local valuations 4−je+5 floor(je/5) and valuation 1 at infinity; their distinct cyclic characters prove they form a basis. Independently extracting the coefficients from x^(2j)(x−1)^(4j+floor(2j/5))(x−t)^(6j+floor(3j/5)) by the binomial theorem verifies all four universal Cartier identities. No further selected powers occur, by degree. The inverse-Frobenius semilinear diagonal has stable rank equal to its instantaneous rank, since each nonzero entry stays nonzero under all twists; the a-number is its nullity. The discriminants 8 and 6 are nonsquares mod 11, so the two different monic irreducible quadratics give four distinct admissible geometric roots in F_121 outside F_11. Since t is nonzero, exactly two diagonal coordinates vanish at each of these roots, and none elsewhere.
residual_risks: Only the specified characteristic and marked family are classified. The exact polynomial check applies to all geometric parameters, not just sampled F_11-points.

evidence: The mass theorem covers cyclic covers with four branch points and weights by the a-number in the split-character case. For this inertia the degree is 4/25 and the marked-to-unmarked stack degree is 4, so the resulting mass is 2/5.
The special-family Newton-polygon classification is not a classification of all tame covers of this genus and degree.
broader_coverage.reasoning: An aggregate weighted mass, even after specialization, gives no locations of zeros or individual stable ranks. The general extraction machinery can be used for the calculation, but does not itself provide these polynomials and their factor-pair vanishing.

evidence: The 2/5 mass is a weighted constraint on nonordinary points; it does not identify their cross-ratios or reduced residue fields. The exact neighbouring result gives a doubled equianharmonic locus in an inequivalent family.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Exact factorization with disjoint irreducible factors, paired coordinate vanishing, and the field of definition are all additional to the general mass and the inequivalent special-family tables.

evidence: Relabelling the branch points changes the cross-ratio by anharmonic transformations, and cyclic generator changes multiply the four inertia exponents by a common unit mod 5.
The closest catalogue calculation has inertia (1,1,2,1) and two equianharmonic marked roots of lambda²−lambda+1; the frozen finding has four distinct inertia values and four quadratic roots.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The multiplicities of the inertia residues are invariant under these operations. A 3+1 inertia type cannot be made equivalent to the four-distinct type, even with the same pair of nonordinary invariants.

exact_database_or_table.reasoning: Neither the tabulated values nor the closest marked Hasse-locus record supply the exact support or the geometric rank strata for the frozen branch signature. The catalogue search was bounded.

originality.rationale: The general mass and Cartier methods and special-family lists are prior work. The supported distinct contribution is the explicit two-quadratic support with exact ranks and field of definition for this all-distinct branch type. The closest catalogue calculation matches prime, genus, and nonordinary rank pair, but has a different, inequivalent inertia type and a different marked locus.
residual_risks: An earlier explicit calculation for the same family could be indexed under a different normalization or quotient description. No claim of exhaustive priority is made.

value.rationale: The cover uses all nontrivial inertia residues and is a natural one-dimensional Hurwitz family in the first characteristic congruent to 1 modulo 5. The exact marked locus, simultaneous rank drop by two rather than one, and minimum residue field resolve parameterwise arithmetic not encoded by a weighted mass or by a table for another family. The result supplies equations for all geometric parameters, not an isolated numerical example.
residual_risks: The marked points are not a count of geometric isomorphism classes. The rank pair is not asserted to classify all Newton polygons or twists.
